name: CellSiteMaintenanceManager
tagline: PM schedules, inspections, power checks, access permits and a site health map for cell towers – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete cell-site maintenance app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: work orders roll up into sites with a 0–100 health score, plotted on a coordinate map; a 7-day schedule with technician capacity; a status board with transition rules; and a power & access workspace for generator fuel, battery backup and landlord / rooftop permits. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to any table without JSON.
features: Site health score with explained deductions
PM compliance and overdue / due-soon flags
Access permits block work until approved
Checklist, findings, fuel and battery readings required to complete
Generator fuel and battery autonomy thresholds with one-click refuel / battery-test jobs
7-day schedule with per-technician capacity, drag and keyboard rescheduling
Bulk assign, priority, reschedule, permit requests, status and CSV export
Undo, back / forward, keyboard and screen-reader support
Phone layout with bottom view bar (320 px+)
